T4.8.message: "यही तीन चिह्न यह श्लोक पुकारता है" reads like a word-for-word copy of the English "the same three marks this verse calls out". In Hindi, पुकारना is used for calling a person or a name, not marks, so the sentence sounds slightly stilted. The rest of the English and Hindi (line translations, bhavartha, annotations, word meanings, asides, notes) is natural and spelled correctly.
T4.8.suggested_fix: यह श्लोक भी इन्हीं तीन चिह्नों से उन्हें पुकारता है।
